title: Roasted Asparagus with Fried Eggs & Homemade Romesco Sauce

steps.text: Wash, dry, and snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus and transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Wash, dry, trim, seed, and thinly slice bell peppers; add to the baking sheet with the asparagus. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat.
Place veggies in the oven and roast until slightly charred and fork-tender, about 12 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, gently crack eggs into the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes.
While the eggs are cooking, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a blender.
Add roasted peppers, sun-dried tomatoes, almonds, oil, vinegar, and paprika to the blender. Blend until smooth.
To serve, divide asparagus, eggs, and Romesco sauce between plates. Top with feta and enjoy!
